description:
Once rewriting and relocation land, the permanent pages are audited together so that they present only supported current behavior under the registered documentation invariants.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A linked audit record covers the root README, `docs/`, crate READMEs, `AGENTS.md` and the crate-root `lib.rs` docs, and cites the invariant address of each finding.
- [hard] REQ-02: Permanent text describes only supported current behavior: historical narration, migration language, superseded alternatives, speculation and future promises are absent, and each finding is fixed in the same change.
- [hard] REQ-03: No performance figure appears outside the performance evidence reference page.
- [hard] REQ-04: For each permanent page the record lists the prior sources mined and confirms, by comparison against them, that no explanatory prose was carried over verbatim.
- [hard] REQ-05: Root `AGENTS.md` states `@/issue/<short-id>`, the form the mechanical documentation check resolves, as the way prose and Rustdoc reference a JIT issue, and every issue reference on the permanent surface uses that form.
title: Audit the permanent surface against the docs invariants
